# Draft:Hemp Republic

Hemp Republic is a Filipino reggae band formed in Los Baños, Laguna. The band has been active for more than two decades and is associated with the Philippine reggae music scene. Hemp Republic released the album Welcome to Hemp Republic in 2005 and later marked its 25th anniversary with the release of The Mighty People in 2025.
History
Hemp Republic was formed in Los Baños, Laguna, and became part of the local reggae and alternative music community in the Philippines. Over the years, the band performed at various venues and music events, contributing to the visibility of reggae music within the local scene.
In February 2025, the band celebrated its 25th anniversary with the release of The Mighty People, a six-track EP. The anniversary was marked by a special album launch and live performance, which received coverage from Philippine music publications and news outlets.
Music media noted that the release included both new material and songs developed over the band’s long career, reflecting its continued presence in the Philippine reggae scene.
Music
Hemp Republic’s music is rooted in reggae and draws from related genres. Coverage of the band’s anniversary release highlighted its long-standing involvement in reggae music in the Philippines and its continued activity after more than two decades.
Members
* Bunny Liwanag – vocals
Discography
* Welcome to Hemp Republic (2005)
* The Mighty People (EP, 2025)
